item.title: 【Requests】[REQ VID] - Live on October 15: Victoria's Secret Fashion Show 2025
item.description:
The Angels are LIVE Tonight

Madison Beer and Karol G will perform their hits, joined by K-pop supergroup TWICE and hip-hop legend Missy Elliott.

Tune in at 6:30PM ET for the Pink Carpet
and 7PM ET for the live show and shopping event.

Will be live on Prime Video, YouTube, Tiktok, Instagram:
https://www.primevideo.com/region/eu/detail/0LXOJGHZ1A4EQJ2R2JHPHK1PV8/ (link for EU, may be different for US)
https://www.youtube.com/@VictoriasSecret

From what I'm reading the show might also be available as a standalone show sometime after the livestream on the Prime Video platform in the US, that would probably be the highest quality that will be available.
